raw_posts.name: CREEM 2.0
raw_posts.tagline: Sell and grow your AI built products
raw_posts.description: - Creem 2.0 is the money platform for the AI building era: sell software and digital products globally, with payments, taxes, payouts, affiliates and usage billing handled for you - The all in one platform for AI builders to turn what they build into a business. Payments, taxes, billing, affiliates, payouts, worldwide. Building a product went from months to a weekend. Getting paid for it did not, with CREEM you can move at the same speed.

raw_posts.name: Bitrise Remote Dev Environments
raw_posts.tagline: Cloud Macs your coding agents can actually build on
raw_posts.description: Bitrise RDE gives you cloud Macs & Linux machines that start in seconds, the same machines, stacks and caches as your CI. Give every agent its machine and run them in parallel via MCP, or attach VS Code, Cursor or Claude Code. Archive when you stop, restore later.

raw_posts.name: Text Agent Store
raw_posts.tagline: A marketplace for AI agents you can text
raw_posts.description: Meet all the agents you can text. Agent Store is a directory of AI agents that live inside a contact in your phone book. Browse an ecosystem of texting agents, and send one text to start using them today. No account, no download, no setup.

raw_posts.name: Modaal for Android
raw_posts.tagline: Ship on both stores from one project using Swift + Kotlin
raw_posts.description: Modaal for Android let you ship one app to both stores with your own AI agent - no rebuild. Rather than one React Native codebase that draws the same screens on both phones, Modaal shares the logic, not the screens: your agent writes real Swift/SwiftUI for iPhone and real Kotlin and Jetpack Compose for Android from one project, and the build proves both behave the same. So anyone who built an iPhone app with Modaal can add Android without touching a line of logic — no credit meters, no rebuild.

raw_posts.name: NovaSynth by Noveum
raw_posts.tagline: Test your voice agent on the callers you can’t stage.
raw_posts.description: Simulate realistic callers at scale with custom personas, scenarios, interruptions, noise, accents, and network conditions. NovaSynth runs those calls against your voice agent, scores audio and transcripts across 30+ dimensions, and surfaces the failures and fixes that matter to your team.

raw_posts.name: Higgsfield API
raw_posts.tagline: One async API for 50+ generative media models
raw_posts.description: Higgsfield API is one authenticated, asynchronous API for generative media. Call Seedance, Kling, Soul, Grok Imagine, Wan, and 50+ frontier models through the same request lifecycle — submit, poll or webhook, download. Explore models in Console, get keys in Cloud, ship with Python/TypeScript SDKs. Pay per use with intro discounts up to 50% off your top models. Build your own Higgsfield at open.higgsfield.ai.

raw_posts.name: MCPJam
raw_posts.tagline: The testing & evaluations platform for MCP servers
raw_posts.description: Run User Testing, Swarms, Evals, and CI/CD gates on your MCP server to see if users actually succeed in ChatGPT, Claude, and Copilot. Test local servers via desktop app, CLI, or SDK.

raw_posts.name: Die With Me
raw_posts.tagline: AIM buddy list for your friends’ Claude Code and Codex usage
raw_posts.description: An AIM buddy list for your AI usage. See friends’ Claude Code and Codex allowances as little mascots on your Mac. Set a status, visit their rooms, and unlock a chatroom when your allowance runs low. Your AI clocks out, but your friends are still here.

raw_posts.name: Figo
raw_posts.tagline: See every move your competitors make
raw_posts.description: Figo watches your competitors so you do not have to. Every week it checks their rankings, new pages, blog posts, Google Ads, Meta ads, TikTok ads, Instagram, Facebook and Reddit, plus what ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and Perplexity say when buyers ask for a recommendation. Monday morning you get a short briefing: what changed, what it means, and one thing to do about it. Add your website and it finds the competitors for you.

raw_posts.name: Zella
raw_posts.tagline: Video recorder that edits itself on Mac and iPhone
raw_posts.description: Zella records your screen or camera and edits the video for you, on your own Mac or iPhone. Nothing uploads, no account, no subscription. Free at 1080p with no watermark. One tap runs Auto-Polish: captions, silence cuts, filler words removed, zoom-ins and a cleaned-up voice. Make it Viral adds pacing, transitions, sound effects and a music bed. Pro is one payment of $89 that unlocks Mac and iPhone together, for life, instead of a monthly bill.
